intelligence.enrichment: In asexual reproduction, one parent produces new individuals that are exact copies in their cell instructions; in vegetative propagation, a new plant can grow from a leaf, stem, or root such as a money plant cutting, potato eye, or piece of ginger. single parent or planted plant part -> copied instructions and new individual -> reproduction without mixing instructions from two parents The learner correctly uses the chapter relationship: In asexual reproduction, one parent produces new individuals that are exact copies in their cell instructions; in vegetative propagation, a new plant can grow from a leaf, stem, or root such as a money plant cutting, potato eye, or piece of ginger. Any new plant that grows from soil must have come from a seed and two parents.
